construction: Locally generated R13/R14 controls attach ACAD EED to the ACAD_MLINESTYLE owner dictionary. Remapped controls use NOD 0x35, ACAD APPID 0x33 and owner dictionary 0x17, and include a separate named GROUP with a 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback checks dictionary ownership and root membership; UTF-8 uses the prior fixed-size codepage-45 patch and repaired source-object CRC. Drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The shared legacy source observer binds the exact ACAD_MLINESTYLE NOD edge, owner, EED frame, APPID and codepage; the MLINESTYLE output profile and standard-object inspector compare the staged owner dictionary and referenced style.

Representable UTF-8 and ASCII EED pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial output with original and remapped source handles. EED, APPID, raw-frame, owner, root-edge and R14 MLINESTYLE edits are checked for refusal, preserved destination and corrected retry.

An aliased source root is refused. Unrepresentable target text is refused in both R14 strict and R13 partial output; the shared physical text guard prevents a decoded escape from falsely certifying literal EED text.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback verifies ACAD EED café and 42 on the MLINESTYLE owner, its Standard style owner, and a separate MYGROUP-to-3D-LINE edge in both output encodings.
limits: R13 output is explicit partial; the MLINESTYLE object itself remains unqualified and strict R13 remains refused.
Only the selected ACAD EED and owner graph are covered; native duplicate/clone semantics, other EED schemas and general DWG/DXF format support remain open.
